question: Can the unchanged Qwen3.5-2B training pipeline fit corrections and abstention controls after five passes over a small bilingual subset?
scope: Fit diagnostic, not a controlled attribution of improvement to balance versus repetition. Reuses existing training groups and targets; all 111 prior development cases plus 64 new pause cases stay development-only. All seven actions remain in the contract and regression evaluation. No sealed test or real media is used.

decision.fit_goal: All 12 corrections, 12 abstentions and 8 caption edits match in training before expanding the corpus. Report each cohort even when the goal fails.
decision.if_fit_fails: Inspect per-example teacher-forced loss, action-token likelihood and optimization before generating more examples.
decision.if_fit_succeeds: Inspect transfer to different development scripts, missing/conflicting evidence, caption language failures, multi-item regressions and the untouched pause-preference diagnostic. Fit alone does not authorize promotion.
